research_question: How does increasing AD-like amyloid-linked inhibitory perturbation differentially affect stimulus-evoked transmission into expanded musical-semantic-associated and musical-episodic-associated proxy parcel sets?

transfer_gain.node: linearly detrended evoked PSP AC-RMS / ipsilateral A1 AC-RMS in the fixed 10-second window
transfer_gain.network: geometric mean of left and right hemisphere means; one-sided sets retain their available hemisphere
transfer_gain.temporal_diagnostic: five 2-second transfer bins, log2 slope, and first-half versus second-half absolute log2 difference
transfer_gain.frequency_locked_sensitivity: median of five 2-second exact-frequency transfer gains

functional_connectivity.node: Fisher-z Pearson correlation between matched-control-subtracted evoked target and ipsilateral A1 PSP traces
functional_connectivity.network: arithmetic mean of hemisphere means with equal hemisphere weight
functional_connectivity.baseline_reference: network evoked FC z minus own baseline
functional_connectivity.interpretation: common-input-sensitive model PSP functional connectivity, not causal effective connectivity

response_latency.node: 50% fractional-energy timing minus ipsilateral A1 timing
response_latency.saved_pulse_descriptors: absolute and signed peak, absolute peak time, peak time relative to ipsilateral A1, and integrated evoked energy
response_latency.network: arithmetic mean of left/right hemisphere medians
response_latency.baseline_reference: network relative latency minus own baseline, ms
response_latency.interpretation: relative model-response timing; zero tract delays mean this is not anatomical conduction latency

frequency_qa.harmonic_phase_convention: y_f=A*sin(2*pi*f*t+phase); phase=atan2(beta_cos,beta_sin); target lag is wrapped target phase minus ipsilateral A1 phase

statistics.interaction: semantic severity slope minus episodic severity slope; with severity coded 0, 0.5, 1 this equals the endpoint difference in baseline-referenced values
statistics.interval: two-sided t interval across paired numerical initializations
statistics.curvature: midpoint interaction minus mean of endpoint interactions

integration_step_gates.comparison_unit: absolute bias in the finite 20-seed mean baseline-to-high semantic-minus-episodic interaction at 0.5 versus 0.25 ms
integration_step_gates.direction_rule: main and reference interaction means must share a sign, unless both are within the outcome tolerance of zero
integration_step_gates.inference_rule: the 95% t-intervals must give the same two-sided zero-exclusion conclusion at both integration steps
integration_step_gates.pointwise_seed_differences: retained as diagnostics; not a hard gate for sensitive nonlinear trajectories
integration_step_gates.fatal_validity_rule: nonfinite estimates, interaction-direction reversal, changed 95% interval conclusion, or failed A1 stimulation quality stop the notebook
integration_step_gates.precision_rule: the unchanged transfer, FC, latency, and A1-SNR tolerances produce warnings and exact-magnitude eligibility labels, not a fatal stop
integration_step_gates.paired_step_bias_interval: two-sided t interval across the 20 paired main-minus-reference seed-level interaction differences
integration_step_gates.amendment_basis: the completed 20-seed comparison preserved interaction direction and the 95% interval conclusion while exceeding three exact-magnitude precision targets

raw_trace_export.trace_transform: none; float PSP monitor samples are saved directly
